resources.string: SMS scam detection · AI on your phone
Choose the interface language. The unchanged AI model checks Traditional and Simplified Chinese SMS; English message detection has not been validated.
Protection is off. You can still paste an SMS for an on-device check.
Incoming SMS checks are enabled and scam warning notifications are available.
Incoming SMS checks are enabled, but notifications are denied or disabled. Results appear only in local history.
SMS access is unavailable. Check system permissions and how the app was installed.
The last on-device check failed. Protection may be unavailable. Try a manual check and review the history.
Checks only SMS that Android allows this app to access. RCS, WhatsApp and some protected verification codes are excluded. Battery saving or system scheduling may delay alerts.
Android 17 may delay access to certain verification-code SMS by three hours. This app cannot check those messages immediately.
Check new SMS on your phone

WiseMessage reads new SMS, analyses them on this phone, and saves their contents and results in private app storage. Only messages meeting the scam warning condition trigger a notification; notifications do not show SMS contents. You can turn protection off at any time. This app does not send or delete SMS, or upload their contents.
SMS access was denied or restricted by Android. Manual checks are still available. For this test installation, see the supplied installation guide.
Enter a Traditional or Simplified Chinese SMS here…
Enter at most 20,000 characters per check.
The on-device check did not finish. Try again; do not interpret this as a safe result.
No high risk detected · Still verify
This message exceeds the model length. Only the beginning was analysed.
AI scores are not a guarantee. Do not reveal passwords, transfer money or install unfamiliar software based on a prediction. Find official contact details independently to verify.
Reads up to the latest 50 inbox SMS and saves their contents and results locally. Original messages are not changed. Old messages do not trigger a series of warning notifications.
%1$d SMS queued. Results will appear in local history as each check finishes.
Cannot read the SMS inbox. Check SMS permissions. Manual checks are still available.
No records yet. Incoming SMS and manual check results will appear here.
Alerts for SMS classified as possible scams. Notifications do not include SMS contents.
Do not pay or share sensitive information. Tap to review on this phone.
This tests notifications. It is not a model detection result.
Warnings are off or blocked. Turn on warnings here and allow notifications in system settings.
Your SMS stays on your phone

The model is included in the app and works entirely offline. Records remain in private app storage with cloud backup disabled. Notifications hide senders and message contents. This is a development test app; notification reliability depends on phone settings.
Local model: loads when you check a message
Private checks, right on your phone

Inbox SMS dated today; excludes messages Android does not expose.

Scan the accessible SMS inbox on this phone.

Enter text for a private, on-device check.
See check totals and results over time.

WiseMessage will read every inbox SMS Android allows it to access, analyse messages on this phone, and keep their contents and results in private app storage. Large inboxes take longer. Original messages stay unchanged. Older SMS will not trigger repeated warning notifications.
Allow WiseMessage to display your accessible inbox SMS on this phone? Messages are not uploaded. Opening a message here does not open its links.

The harmful group includes possible spam and scams; automatic incoming warnings are sent only for scam decisions. Review includes uncertain, waiting and failed checks. No high risk detected is not proof that a message is legitimate.
Shows up to 20 SMS per page. Previous and Next replace the current page instead of making a longer list.
Shows up to 20 results per page. Change the filter to start from its first page.

Waiting and failed counts cover all records; a dash means no daily breakdown is available.
